task_policy: Each task independently checks the frozen date allowlist, waits without claim or scientific calls until 09:00Z, creates its own atomic claim, and may start scientific acquisition only [09:00Z,09:05Z). Late starts claim MISSED_NO_ACQUISITION. Every task checks the clock again immediately before EE/Kalshi acquisition.
weathernext_policy: Historical preflight metadata verified 24 exact hourly bands from one 00Z init per city; runtime requires all 24 rows, exact init/valid time, fixed reviewed grid point, and ingestion strictly before 09:00Z; missing or late data becomes DATA_NOT_READY with no retry.
market_policy: At decision, capture each city's exact event and all six active sibling market/rule/bounds/quote/depth objects with retrieval timestamps. Reject source, city, ticker, ladder, inactive market, missing quotes/depth, and nonempty outcome fields.
credential_policy: Separate multicity Secret Manager credential containing dedicated Earth Engine user OAuth with only https://www.googleapis.com/auth/earthengine.readonly; mount into separate multicity runtime identity. Do not copy or mutate Chicago's secret or runtime job.
service_account_policy: Separate multicity runtime service account with secret-level accessor for its own OAuth secret and object creator/viewer only on a new multicity evidence bucket; Scheduler identity has invoker on the multicity job only.
evidence_bucket: new dedicated multicity GCS bucket required before building; no Chicago bucket writes
immutability: All objects use GCS if_generation_match=0 and retry=None; runtime role has no overwrite or delete permission. Packet records SHA-256 of exact weather, market, and forecast bytes and is sealed before any outcome path.
one_city_failure_isolation: A failed city task writes only its own claim/failure path and cannot retry or overwrite another city's evidence; the overall job may fail while other city packets remain sealed.
future_build_gate: Paused job/scheduler may be built from a pinned reviewed image only after separate bucket, IAM, credential, and timing canary readback; this design authorizes no scheduler enable or scientific execution.
